text: Other physical agents: thermal insulation or personnel protection shall be provided for surfaces above 60 degC that can be touched from platforms and walkways (protection to a height of 2.1 m and 0.8 m from the edge); confined spaces (tanks, pits, the condenser water boxes, the CW tunnel) shall have permanent gas monitoring connections, two access points where practical and rescue provisions; lightning protection per IEC 62305 for all buildings and structures with the ground flash density of the site (DP-OWNR-0009).
